, by using a state-based IDS, it is possible to detect complex attacks that are undetectable by traditional packet-level intrusion detection systems.
it is possible to build a generic IDS able to detect a large set of complex attacks on a SCADA system, without requiring any knowledge about the specific protocol used for its communication.
